long_biography.plain_text:
In 2001, Savage established Excelerate Technology to solve communications failures in remote locations and at major incidents. Its engineers brought together satellite links, mobile data, wireless networks, live video and on-scene command tools for police, fire, ambulance and government users. He was also named as inventor on a patented system that unified this equipment through a single interface.

Savage still leads the business as chairman and CEO and owns more than three quarters of its shares. Under his direction, Excelerate moved the resilient-connectivity model into healthcare, utilities, logistics and other critical environments. The company focuses on keeping voice, data, imagery and operational awareness flowing when ordinary public infrastructure is damaged, congested or absent.
